results: Link reading is uncluttered at 320px, and keyboard traversal skips nested closed paste controls in both directions
Pasted drafts reopen visibly and retain their text without any network or provider call
Clip controls expose linked time-format and validation descriptions and clear invalid state after correction
Keyboard pagination focuses the announced result range even on the final page, then tabs naturally into the new excerpts
Transcript filtering updates one persistent live result region without stealing typing focus or making another provider call
Multiple clip choosers have distinct source-and-range group names and accessible source headings at desktop width
Cancellation announces completion, rejects late transcript results, and Escape restores the Review sources trigger
Unavailable video support is connected to the URL field and leaves the selected provider unchanged
selftests: Clip validation check fails when aria-invalid is removed
Keyboard check fails when focus escapes to body
